sermon.title: The Drawing of Jesus — August 14, 2022
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: Jesus draws people like a magnet through His word. The woman with the issue of blood, the sinful woman and Zacchaeus responded despite every obstacle. Rejecting Him is a choice; Christians must share His word, watch and warn as people are drawn away.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: The 1657–1990 section repeats the text of the short clip “Does Jesus Want Us to Repent?”, recorded during this service.

Go therefore and make disciples of all the nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, teaching them to observe all things that I have commanded you; and lo, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.
